---
title: "00.Cluster_phenotypes"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-10-29"
output: html_document
---

Joins the ResFinder phenotype table to the CD-HIT gene clusters (90 % identity, `resfinder_cdhit90.clstr`, the
same threshold as the MASTER food resistome, Quijada et al. 2025) and names every cluster as a **gene family**.
`gene_family` is the unit of every ARG metric in the project, and the same clustering is what allows the
MASTER gene list to be applied family by family in `06.ARG_WHO_classification.Rmd`.

Naming, in order (decisions and gene-by-gene tables in `Data/Docs/Gene_family_curation.md`):

1. **representative**: the `gene_base` of the cluster representative;
2. **mosaic**: if the representative is a tet mosaic (`tet(.../...)`), the most frequent non-mosaic gene of the
   cluster, or its most frequent gene if all are mosaics;
3. **parent**: if one gene of the cluster is a prefix of all the others (aph(3')-III in aph(3')-IIIa), that gene,
   unless another cluster already carries that name;
4. **root**: if all genes share one allele root (blaTEM-...) and no gene of any other cluster has that root,
   the root;
5. **curation** (`Data/Raw/Phenotypes/gene_family_curation.tsv`): manual aliases for clusters whose name was
   an arbitrary or wrong allele, and the split of SHV from LEN variants in the blaLEN3 cluster, the only
   assignment made per variant instead of per cluster.

Clusters or variants that end with the same name are summed downstream.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# CD-HIT truncates sequence names to this many characters in the .clstr file
clstr_name_length <- 19
```

# Parse CD-HIT clusters

```{r clusters}
cluster_raw <- tibble(
  line = readLines(here("Data", "Raw", "Phenotypes", "resfinder_cdhit90.clstr"), warn = FALSE)
) %>%
  mutate(line = trimws(line))

cluster_members <- cluster_raw %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = if_else(
      str_detect(line, "^>Cluster\\s+"),
      as.integer(str_match(line, "^>Cluster\\s+(\\d+)")[, 2]),
      NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  fill(cluster) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(line, "^>Cluster\\s+"))

parsed_lines <- str_match(
  cluster_members$line,
  "^\\s*(\\d+)\\s+(\\d+)nt,\\s+>(.*?)\\.\\.\\.\\s*(.*)\\s*$"
)

cluster_members <- cluster_members %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_gene = parsed_lines[, 4],
    # El asterisco identifica al representante
    is_representative = parsed_lines[, 5] == "*"
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, cluster_gene, is_representative)

cat("Clusters:", n_distinct(cluster_members$cluster), "| sequences:", nrow(cluster_members), "\n")
```

# Join with phenotypes

```{r join}
phenotypes <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "Phenotypes", "phenotypes.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(str_sub(phenotypes$gene, 1, clstr_name_length)))

phenotypes_complete <- phenotypes %>%
  mutate(phenotype_row_id = row_number(),
         cluster_gene = str_sub(gene, 1, clstr_name_length)) %>%
  left_join(cluster_members, by = "cluster_gene", relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  relocate(cluster_gene, .after = cluster)

cat("Genes without cluster:", sum(is.na(phenotypes_complete$cluster)), "\n")
stopifnot(!anyNA(phenotypes_complete$cluster))
```

# Gene family names (rule)

```{r naming rule}
is_mosaic <- function(gene) str_detect(gene, "^tet\\(.*/.*\\)")
allele_root <- function(gene) str_remove(str_remove(gene, "-?[0-9]+[A-Za-z]?$"), "[.-]$")
# Most frequent gene, or NA when the top count is tied
most_frequent <- function(gene) {
  counts <- sort(table(gene), decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(counts) == 0 || (length(counts) > 1 && counts[1] == counts[2])) NA_character_ else names(counts)[1]
}

rule_names <- phenotypes_complete %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    representative = gene_base[is_representative][1],
    mosaic_name = if (is_mosaic(representative)) {
      coalesce(most_frequent(gene_base[!is_mosaic(gene_base)]), gene_base[!is_mosaic(gene_base)][1],
               most_frequent(gene_base), representative)
    } else NA_character_,
    parent = {
      genes <- unique(gene_base)
      parents <- genes[map_lgl(genes, ~ all(str_starts(genes, fixed(.x))))]
      if (length(genes) > 1 && length(parents) == 1) parents else NA_character_
    },
    n_genes = n_distinct(gene_base),
    root = if (n_distinct(allele_root(gene_base)) == 1) allele_root(gene_base[1]) else NA_character_,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(mosaic_name = na_if(mosaic_name, representative),
         name_12 = coalesce(mosaic_name, representative))

# A parent name or a root is used only if no other cluster already has it
other_names <- function(name, this_cluster) name %in% rule_names$name_12[rule_names$cluster != this_cluster]
gene_roots <- phenotypes_complete %>% distinct(cluster, root = allele_root(gene_base))
root_elsewhere <- function(root, this_cluster) root %in% gene_roots$root[gene_roots$cluster != this_cluster]

rule_names <- rule_names %>%
  mutate(use_parent = !is.na(parent) & parent != name_12 & !map2_lgl(parent, cluster, other_names),
         use_root = is.na(mosaic_name) & !use_parent & !is.na(root) & root != name_12 & n_genes >= 2 & nchar(root) >= 3 &
           !map2_lgl(root, cluster, root_elsewhere),
         gene_family = case_when(use_parent ~ parent, use_root ~ root, TRUE ~ name_12),
         naming_step = case_when(use_parent ~ "parent", use_root ~ "root",
                                 !is.na(mosaic_name) ~ "mosaic", TRUE ~ "representative"))

count(rule_names, naming_step)
rule_names %>% filter(naming_step != "representative") %>% select(cluster, representative, gene_family, naming_step)
```

# Manual curation

```{r curation}
curation <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "Phenotypes", "gene_family_curation.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

representatives <- phenotypes_complete %>% filter(is_representative) %>% select(cluster, cluster_representative = gene)
curation <- curation %>% left_join(representatives, by = "cluster_representative", relationship = "many-to-one")

# Every curation row must point at an existing cluster representative
stopifnot(!anyNA(curation$cluster))

aliases <- curation %>% filter(action == "alias")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(aliases$cluster))
rule_names <- rule_names %>%
  left_join(aliases %>% select(cluster, alias = gene_family), by = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(naming_step = if_else(!is.na(alias), "alias", naming_step),
         gene_family = coalesce(alias, gene_family)) %>%
  select(-alias)

# An alias must not take the name of a cluster that is not itself curated
uncurated <- rule_names %>% filter(!cluster %in% aliases$cluster)
stopifnot(!any(aliases$gene_family %in% uncurated$gene_family))

phenotypes_complete <- phenotypes_complete %>%
  left_join(rule_names %>% select(cluster, gene_family, naming_step), by = "cluster")

# Per-variant splits: variants of the cluster matching the pattern take their own family
splits <- curation %>% filter(action == "split_by_gene")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(splits))) {
  moved <- phenotypes_complete$cluster == splits$cluster[i] &
    str_detect(phenotypes_complete$gene_base, splits$gene_pattern[i])
  cat("Split", splits$cluster_representative[i], ":", sum(moved), "variants ->", splits$gene_family[i], "\n")
  stopifnot(sum(moved) > 0)
  phenotypes_complete$gene_family[moved] <- splits$gene_family[i]
  phenotypes_complete$naming_step[moved] <- "split"
}

stopifnot(!anyNA(phenotypes_complete$gene_family))
cat("Variants:", nrow(phenotypes_complete), "| clusters:", n_distinct(phenotypes_complete$cluster),
    "| gene families:", n_distinct(phenotypes_complete$gene_family), "\n")
phenotypes_complete %>% distinct(cluster, naming_step) %>% count(naming_step)
```

```{r save}
write_tsv(phenotypes_complete %>% select(-gene_base) %>% relocate(gene_family, naming_step, .after = gene),
          here("Data", "Processed", "phenotypes_cluster.tsv"))
```
